title: AdapterData
description: Results of an adapter update including item and meta data.

adapter.description: The adapter determines where the source data comes from and how it is processed.

name.description: Name of the adapter, can be used as reference.

lastUpdate.description: Timestamp of the last successful data fetch. This can differ from the last change of the data.

version.description: Version of the current data set, can be referenced to retrieve diffs instead of whole data sets.

itemsRecord.description: Item data; each property holds the data for one item. The property keys do not necessarily coincide with the id property of the item, but often do.

title.title: title
title.description: Title - What is the title of your service or offer? What is the name of your place or institution? If you would like to enter a location or an institution, please enter the exact title or name here. Please be precise, so that users will be able to find it quickly.

titleAddOn.title: titleAddOn
titleAddOn.description: If the title is no proper noun, but instead supposed to be translated in the UI, you can add a title version for each language here; e.g. if title is 'Görlitzer Park' leave this property empty. If instead it is 'Stadtpark' add { 'en': 'City park'}.

^[a-z]{2}$.description: Text content translated into the language determined by the language code used in this property's key. (e.g. 'en' or 'de')

image.title: image
image.description: Image - Image URL (insert a picture link here, for example http://www.domain.de/bild.jpg)

tags.title: tags
tags.description: List of lower case string tags; [a-z0-9_-] will work. A list of already in use tags and their labels can be found here: https://mappo.mittendrin.in/tt/latest - Type of entry

brief.title: brief
brief.description: Caption - The short description appears in the search results list. It should be a brief explanation of your service or facility. More space for a detailed description will be available in the next section.

^[a-z]{2}$.description: Text content translated into the language determined by the language code used in this property's key. (e.g. 'en' or 'de')

description.title: description
description.description: Description - Please give a brief and easily understandable description which allows users to get a quick overview. Try to avoid difficult language and technical terms.

^[a-z]{2}$.description: Text content translated into the language determined by the language code used in this property's key. (e.g. 'en' or 'de')

location_ref.title: location_ref
location_ref.description: This property holds the id of another item. All location data from that other item will be mirror for the current item. - Reference to location - Enter some part of the title or the address of an already added location. You will then be able to choose a matching title or location from a list of options.

location.title: location
location.description: Location - Name of the location (for example “Sozialstation Torstraße”)

^[a-z]{2}$.description: Text content translated into the language determined by the language code used in this property's key. (e.g. 'en' or 'de')

recurring_event.title: recurring_event
recurring_event.description: Recurring hours. Stringified array of rules. Each rule is also an array; e.g. '[[weekly","mon","15:45","16:45",null]]' rule[0] is the iteration interval represented by one of these strings: 'fixed', 'daily', 'mon-fri', 'weekly', 'bi-weekly', 'three-weekly', 'four-weekly', 'first_of_month', 'second_of_month', 'third_of_month', 'fourth_of_month', 'last_of_month'; rule[1] is the day of week represented by one of these strings: 'mon', 'tue', 'wed', 'thu', 'fri', 'sat', 'sun' - not always neccessaryary; rule[2] is the start time represented by a string in HH:MM format, rule[3] is the end time represented by a string in HH:MM format; rule[4] is one example date formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD', the example date is not always neccessary. Omitted values should be null. - Regular hours

sponsors.title: sponsors
sponsors.description: Sponsored by: - You can add the institution here that is supporting the service or facility financially.

contact.title: contact
contact.description: Contact - A person who is responsible for the service or in charge of answering questions.

phone.title: phone
phone.description: Phone - Please enter the phone number including the international code.

mobile.title: mobile
mobile.description: Mobile phone number - Please enter mobile number with international code

hours.title: hours
hours.description: Opening or service hours, free text - Provide information on dates and times that could not be accommodated elsewhere in the form.

^[a-z]{2}$.description: Text content translated into the language determined by the language code used in this property's key. (e.g. 'en' or 'de')

accessibility.title: accessibility
accessibility.description: Accessibility - Is the location / the service accessible for everyone?

^[a-z]{2}$.description: Text content translated into the language determined by the language code used in this property's key. (e.g. 'en' or 'de')

charge.title: charge
charge.description: Fees - Any charges by the provider must be entered here.
